privacy.title: Privacy & Your Data
privacy.subtitle: Short, plain English explaining what we collect and why.

whoRuns.heading: 1. Who runs this
whoRuns.body: LSE Spots is an independent student project created by students. It is not run by, managed by, or affiliated with the London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE). The data controller for this project is the LSE Spots Student Project Team (contact: morgancanteri15@gmail.com / privacy@lsespots.app).

whatCollect.heading: 2. What we collect
whatCollect.tableZoneDesc: The specific room or area you scanned
whatCollect.tableLevelDesc: Whether you selected Plenty of seats, Filling up, or Full
whatCollect.tableDeviceDesc: A one-way hash of a random code on your phone, used to prevent duplicate reports
whatCollect.tableIpDesc: A one-way scrambled hash of part of your network IP address, kept up to 24 hours only to stop automated spam
whatCollect.tableFeedbackDesc: If you send feedback: your message, optional reply email, page, and date, used to fix bugs and improve the app (kept 12 months)

whatNotCollect.heading: 3. What we do not collect
whatNotCollect.body: We do not collect your name, your email address (unless you choose to provide it in feedback for a reply), your LSE student ID, or your university login. We do not access your GPS location, camera, microphone, photos, or contacts. You do not need to create an account, and we do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.

whyCollect.heading: 4. Why we collect it
whyCollect.body: Under UK data protection laws, we collect this minimal data based on legitimate interests: helping students find available study seats across campus quickly, preventing spam or abusive submissions, and fixing bugs and improving the app when you send feedback.

howLong.heading: 5. How long we keep it
howLong.body: Individual seat reports are permanently deleted after 12 months. Feedback messages and optional reply emails are deleted after 12 months. Anonymous hourly statistics (which cannot identify any device) are kept to calculate typical busy hours. Temporary spam-prevention network hashes are deleted within 24 hours. Suggestion routing events are cleared after 7 days.

whoHandles.heading: 6. Who else handles it
whoHandles.body: Our hosting is provided by Vercel (London / EU region), and our database runs on Supabase (London / EU region). Spam and bot protection is powered by Cloudflare Turnstile without tracking cookies. Optional feedback notifications are relayed via our notification service. Site analytics are cookieless and record no personal data.

storage.heading: 7. Cookies and device storage
storage.body: We do not use tracking or advertising cookies. We store a single random identifier in your browser's local storage ('lse_client_random_id') so you cannot submit multiple reports for the same space within 10 minutes. We also store your visit days and whether you dismissed the install message, on your device only, never sent to us. This is strictly necessary for anti-spam and app functionality, meaning no cookie pop-up banner is required.

yourRights.heading: 8. Your rights
yourRights.body: You have the right to view, correct, or delete any data linked to your device, and to lodge a complaint with the UK Information Commissioner's Office (ICO at ico.org.uk). Because we store no names or logins, we can only locate reports made from your current browser.

lastUpdated.heading: 9. Changes and last updated
lastUpdated.body: If we make changes to how data is handled, we will post an update here. Last updated: October 2026.
